_comment: Acknowledgements for `npm run context:staleness`. A line lands here when its cited code has churned but the CLAIM is still true — typically a stable design rule or a pointer, as opposed to a description of an implementation that moved. Each ackKey hashes file + line TEXT + cited path, so editing the line VOIDS its ack automatically and the line returns to the report. That is what stops this becoming a permanent blindfold: an ack asserts 'I checked this wording', not 'never ask again'. Verify before adding one — the whole value of the report is that it makes someone check.

acks.line: AGENTS.md — **Design rule**: all cross-skill writes go through `scripts/cross-skill.mjs`.
acks.reason: A design RULE, not a description of implementation. cross-skill.mjs churns constantly because it is the facade every skill writes through — which is the rule holding, not breaking.
